meta.note: Compositions per Furtwängler et al. 1906 (west 13 figures, pp. 195, 312; later east 11 figures, p. 312). Figure order, facing and x are inferred (choices.pediment-figure-order); x positions are provisional for Step 4.

west.label: West pediment: the (second) Trojan War, Athena central, six figures each side in two groups of three
west.note: Thirteen figures lettered A-N without J (pp. 195, 197, 312): three victors and three vanquished on each side. Count and grouping are attested in the 1906 reconstruction; the current Glyptothek (Ohly) arrangement was not retrieved.

eastOptions.label: Earlier east pediment (replaced; known only indirectly)
eastOptions.note: Known only from cornice blocks with sockets that do not fit the final east front (Wikipedia citing Bankel and Eschbach; unverified). Figure count, subject and layout not found.

eastOptions.label: Later east pediment: the first Trojan War, Herakles and Telamon against Laomedon, Athena central
eastOptions.note: Eleven figures, five each side of Athena (p. 312). Displaying it on a c. 500 BC temple is interpretive (choices.east-pediment-displayed).
